instr: Color or shape: a cue word tells you whether to judge the COLOR or the SHAPE of the figure that follows.
clue: First a cue appears: COLOR or SHAPE. Then a blue or orange circle or square appears. If the cue is COLOR: blue = left, orange = right. If the cue is SHAPE: circle = left, square = right. Use the arrow keys or the buttons. Answer quickly and accurately. Press Start when ready.
